name: Mutant

bonuses.name: Mutative
bonuses.text: Any time a Mutant deals a Wound, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

abilities.name: Unnatural Regeneration
abilities.text: Whenever a Mutant rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, the Mutant regains 1D3 Wounds.

mobAbilities.name: Mutant Rabble
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Mutants gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Mutants.

note: Reprint of mutant; differs in keywords (CHAOS HERETIC MUTANT, no SCUM), Default 3 (Core 5), Weapon Skill 5 (6), Awareness and Stealth, weapon, Wrath ability, Tier 5, Mob rule.
